name: food-delivery-devops
description: DevOps-based food delivery application with microservices architecture

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd services/restaurant-service && npm install && cd ../order-service && npm install && cd ../delivery-service && npm install && cd ../../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "RESTAURANT,ORDER,DELIVERY,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev:restaurant" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:delivery" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:restaurant && npm run test:order && npm run test:delivery
